string.text: Nah, don't need it. Money's tight right now.

Listen, need a cool gun? I found something near Yantar... there was a stash there, basically. Among the stuff, there was a Gauss rifle. Excellent piece of work, I tell you - drops anyone dead from a hundred meters. I can let it go if you're interested. For only eight hundred, I'll bring it out in two minutes!
Help, hurry... They'll be back soon...
Thanks for saving me. I'd be a goner without you!
Alive, give me a medkit, quick!
Marked One! The military has attacked the bandit base. They have blocked the way to the Garbage. But there is an old road to the south. Try to get out that way, but be careful. Good luck.
Hello, Marked One, glad you are alive, and you even dropped by our fire. Come in, let's talk. Another job is shaping up.
I have been to X-18. Here are the documents.

Hm... aha... Now this is very interesting! If I told people, they would not believe it. Hm-m... uh-huh... well, look at that! I never imagined... things are really bad. Anyway. Take them back. All of this has to go to the Barkeep, and you have earned a reward for your trouble!
